+++ b/tests/test_response_dependency.py
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Response, status
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from typing_extensions import Annotated
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+
+def modify_response(response: Response):
+    response.headers["X-Test"] = "test"
+    return response
+
+
+@app.get("/annotated", status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
+def annotated(response: Annotated[Response, Depends(modify_response)]):
+    return {"message": "test"}
+
+
+@app.get("/default", status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
+def default(response: Response = Depends(modify_response)):  # noqa: B008
+    return {"message": "test"}
+
+
+@app.get("/injected", status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
+def injected(response: Response):
+    response.headers["X-Test"] = "test"
+    return {"message": "test"}
+
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+def test_annotated():
+    response = client.get("/annotated")
+    assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_200_OK, response.text
+    assert response.json() == {"message": "test"}
+    assert response.headers["X-Test"] == "test"
+
+
+def test_default():
+    response = client.get("/default")
+    assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_200_OK, response.text
+    assert response.json() == {"message": "test"}
+    assert response.headers["X-Test"] == "test"
+
+
+def test_injected():
+    response = client.get("/injected")
+    assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_200_OK, response.text
+    assert response.json() == {"message": "test"}
+    assert response.headers["X-Test"] == "test"
